outcome: sensitivity of LATCH tool for predicting non-exclusive breastfeeding
specificity of LATCH tool for predicting non-exclusive breastfeeding
cohort: 907 women who had recently given birth in Singapore
finding: The 4-item LATCH breastfeeding assessment tool demonstrated sound psychometric properties compared to the 5-item version in a multiethnic population.
mod_finding: The sensitivity and specificity of the LATCH tool for predicting non-exclusive breastfeeding differed between vaginally delivered and cesarean delivered women.
